newsitem.title: USA: SPX to sell Hy-Lift unit.
newsitem.headline: SPX to sell Hy-Lift unit.

text.p: SPX Corp said Friday it agreed to sell the assets of its Hy-Lift Dvision for undisclosed terms to W.A. Thomas Co, a maker of valves and precision turned parts in Taylor, Mich.

Hy-Lift makes valve train components for internal combustion engines at Michigan facilities in Muskegon and Zeeland. It has 271 workers, and does not expect workforce changes as a result of the transaction.

W.A. Thomas said the business will help it to continue to grow as a supplier to the worldwide automotive and industrial markets. The company, which employs 170 workers, has manufacturing facilities in Chelsea, Mich. and Huntsville, Ala.
Hy-Lift will operate as a subsidiary of W.A. Thomas. SPX will hold an equity position in that unit, the companies said. The deal is expected to be completed in 30 days.
